name: 10xdev
description: Interview-driven scaffolding and a strict-but-friendly quality apparatus for Python GenAI projects. Bundles four composable skills: project-scaffold (one-pass src-layout generator), quality-gates (ruff/type/security/size/naming gates + hooks + CI behind one `task ci-check`), ai-project-guidance (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md following Clean Code), and git-setup (branch model + protection). Designed so junior engineers get production-grade structure and the conventions explain themselves.
